summary.headline: Ipca Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin rose to 20.52% from 18.24%; FY27 guided to 12-13% growth and 1-1.25pp margin expansion.
summary.overview: Management reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of about INR2,388 crores (up 6% YoY per the call's stated figure) and FY26 consolidated revenue of about INR9,646 crores (up 8%). Standalone EBITDA margin was 25.27% in Q4 (vs 21.19%) and 25.18% for FY26 (vs 22.66%). Management guided FY27 consolidated growth of 12-13% and consolidated EBITDA margin of about 22-22.3%, but flagged rising input costs (solvents, packaging, APIs) and freight costs linked to the Iran-US/Strait of Hormuz disruption. Unichem margins fell to about 8% and are guided to 12-13% for FY27.

segments.name: Domestic formulations
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 INR853 crores (+12%); FY26 INR3,817 crores (+10%). Branded grew 14% in FY26, institutional fell about 24% to INR270 crores (Q4 INR74 crores vs INR111 crores). Ipca ranked 16th in MAT March '26 with 2.09% share (2.08% in Dec '25).

segments.name: Export formulations
segments.commentary: FY26 INR2,083 crores (+9%). Promotional branded exports grew about 14% to INR664 crores; generics ex-tenders grew about 17% to INR1,149 crores.

segments.name: API
segments.commentary: FY26 INR1,396 crores (+10%). Management said API price increases are being passed through to buyers.

segments.name: US (Ipca USA + Unichem USA)
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 INR428 crores (+10%); FY26 INR1,567 crores (+14%). Unichem US expected to grow about 10% in FY27; about 8 Ipca US generics marketed, 6-8 launches planned in FY27 by Ipca.

segments.name: Unichem (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: EBITDA margin fell from about 12% to about 8% with flat turnover; Q4 other expenses rose by INR10-12 crores on tech transfers to third-party US manufacturers. Ireland facility closed; guided margin 12-13% in FY27.

segments.name: Subsidiaries and others
segments.commentary: Trophic Wellness (nutraceuticals) revenue about INR125 crores with profit about INR40 crores. Krebs Bio Nellore plant EBITDA positive; second plant has polishing issues. Onyx Scientific facing weak inquiry levels; UK formulation subsidiary lost INR2-3 million. Pisgah Labs formulation plant to be ready for commissioning around Q4 FY27, with meaningful turnover expected in FY28.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue growth guided at 12-13% in INR terms (not currency-adjusted), with India and promotional markets at 12-13% and CIS at 10-11%.
FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin guided at about 22-22.3%, from 20.7% in FY26; standalone margin expansion guided at 1-1.25pp, below the earlier 1.5pp-plus norm due to material costs.
Domestic branded business guided at about 12% for FY27, with 1-2% from new products and the balance from price and volume.
Price increases of 6-7% expected in decontrolled domestic products; generic price increases are slower to pass through, with about 0.5-0.75% material cost impact expected.
Unichem FY27: US growth about 10%, EBITDA margin 12-13%.
Material costs could rise 10-12% if current petroleum prices persist; freight rose about 25% in Q4 and remains elevated.
capex_capacity: Pisgah Labs (US) formulation facility under construction; readiness for commissioning expected in Q4 FY27, with meaningful turnover in FY28.
Pisgah API facility reporting good order position.
Unichem Ireland manufacturing closed; production shifted to India; EUR 4-5 million annual overhead saving expected to stop in FY27.
Shipping mix changed at Unichem: air freight fell from about 40% a year ago to about 4-5% of shipments, adding some inventory in transit.
demand_pricing: Domestic branded growth driven by CIS and French-speaking Africa in exports, and pain, cardiac, derma, neuro and CNS in India.
Domestic institutional business fell on government funding constraints.
Solvent prices 40-50% above January levels; paracetamol and metformin prices up significantly; overall material cost up about 10-12% in the market.
Material cost to sales ratio about 25% for Ipca; management says input inflation can be offset by price rise and mix.
UK pricing was weak in FY26 but showing improvement with supply shortages.
Freight costs up about 25% in Q4; air cargo availability constrained and some shipments waiting 10-15 days.

qa_highlights.question: How many launches per year are needed to grow 15-20%, and what is the Q1-Q2 FY27 pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Domestic launches of about 18-20 products a year across 20 divisions, with 2-3 power brands per division. US generics: 6-8 launches in FY27 for Ipca; Unichem 5-6. Europe and other markets: 3-4 generic launches per market per year.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the US revenue and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Consolidated US revenue was INR428 crores in Q4 (+10%) and INR1,567 crores in FY26 (+14%). Management guided FY27 Unichem US growth of about 10%.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the gross margin improvement and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Standalone material cost fell about 2% against roughly 10% growth for most of FY26. Margin gains came mainly from mix: domestic, ROW, cardiac, generics and API. Unichem's margin decline partly offset gains.

qa_highlights.question: What is the raw material and price outlook for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Input costs have risen sharply since February. Management expects 10-12% material cost inflation if petroleum prices hold, offset by 6-7% price increases in decontrolled products. Generic pass-through is slower, with about 0.5-0.75% material cost impact.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for Unichem margins and inventory?
qa_highlights.answer: Margin guided at 12-13% for FY27, supported by closing Ireland, lower overheads and a US growth of about 10%. Inventory rose partly from a shift from air to sea freight (air fell from about 40% to 4-5%); management sees no concern.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of Lyka Labs, Krebs Bio and other subsidiaries?
qa_highlights.answer: Lyka is an associate; management said profitability is lower as new animal health and critical care teams mature. Trophic Wellness had about INR125 crores revenue and INR40 crores plus profit. Krebs Nellore is EBITDA positive; the second plant has polishing issues. Onyx Scientific has weak inquiry levels.

risks_watch: Input cost inflation (solvents, packaging, APIs) at 10-12% if petroleum prices stay high, with partial offset from price increases.
Freight and air cargo disruption tied to the Iran-US conflict and Strait of Hormuz; freight up about 25% in Q4 and expected to affect Q1 FY27.
Unichem margin recovery to 12-13% and inventory levels, given its US share losses and higher transit inventory.
Pisgah Labs formulation plant commissioning slipping from Q4 FY27 and Onyx Scientific's weak inquiry levels.
Domestic institutional business declining on government funding constraints (FY26 down about 24%).
Lyka (associate) profitability pressure from field force expansion.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and margin delivery, with a cautious note on near-term input cost and freight pressure. Management was candid on Unichem's weakness and subsidiary losses, but gave few specifics on Lyka and Onyx.
